<style id='wp-block-template-skip-link-inline-css'>

		.skip-link.screen-reader-text {
			border: 0;
			clip-path: inset(50%);
			height: 1px;
			margin: -1px;
			overflow: hidden;
			padding: 0;
			position: absolute !important;
			width: 1px;
			word-wrap: normal !important;
		}

		.skip-link.screen-reader-text:focus {
			background-color: #eee;
			clip-path: none;
			color: #444;
			display: block;
			font-size: 1em;
			height: auto;
			left: 5px;
			line-height: normal;
			padding: 15px 23px 14px;
			text-decoration: none;
			top: 5px;
			width: auto;
			z-index: 100000;
		}
/*# sourceURL=wp-block-template-skip-link-inline-css */
</style>

<div class="entry-content wp-block-post-content is-layout-constrained wp-block-post-content-is-layout-constrained">
<p>By conducting surveys and studies on timely and relevant topics, NIRI helps to advance and elevate the practice of investor relations.</p>



<h5 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-niri-pulse-polls"><strong>NIRI Pulse Polls </strong></h5>



<p>NIRI was established, in part, to study the practice of investor relations. NIRI&#8217;s Pulse Polls are concise, timely surveys designed to gather data and report timely results on issues of interest to investor relations professionals.</p>


<ul class="quicklinks ">      
      <li class="quicklinks__item quicklinks__item--1" >
          <a href="https://niri.org/publications/research/current-pulse-poll/" class="quicklinks__link" >
            <span class="quicklinks__media">
                          </span>

            <div class="quicklinks__content">
                            <strong class="quicklinks__title">
                Participate in the current open survey</strong>
                          </div>

          </a>
        </li>
          
      <li class="quicklinks__item quicklinks__item--2" >
          <a href="https://niri.org/publications/research/pulse-polls-reports/" class="quicklinks__link" >
            <span class="quicklinks__media">
                          </span>

            <div class="quicklinks__content">
                            <strong class="quicklinks__title">
                Pulse poll reports (Members Only)</strong>
                          </div>

          </a>
        </li>
      </ul>
     



<h5 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-ai-within-ir"><strong>AI within IR</strong></h5>



<p>NIRI and UF collaborated on a survey to understand the use of AI within investor relations (IR). The goal was to understand how IR professionals feel about incorporating these new technologies into their daily activities.</p>



<p><a href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/2025-niri-and-university-of-florida">2025 NIRI and University of Florida Research Survey on AI within IR Study Results</a> (Members Only)</p>



<h5 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-ir-profession-and-compensation"><strong>IR Profession and Compensation</strong></h5>



<p>IR profession compensation trends including research from NIRI&#8217;s collaboration with Korn Ferry. Data on base salaries, bonus, equity and additional benefits, career trajectory, IR budgets, reporting structure, professional and administrative staff sizes, as well as demographics of the profession and working environments.</p>



<p><a href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/2024-niri-and-korn-ferry-investor-r">2024 NIRI and Korn Ferry Investor Relations Study Results</a> (Members Only)<br><br><a href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/niri-korn-ferry-investor-relations">2022 NIRI and Korn Ferry Investor Relations Compensation Study Results</a>&nbsp;(Members Only)</p>



<h5 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-targeting-new-investors"><strong>Targeting New Investors</strong></h5>



<p>In an era characterized by dynamic financial landscapes and evolving investor preferences, this research report delves into myriad strategies for targeting investors. Examining various methods, we explore how advancements in data analytics and personalized communication are reshaping the landscape of investor outreach, offering insights into effective targeting approaches for modern financial markets.</p>



		<div class="button-group button-group--justify-center button-group--align-top ">
			

		<a
			class="button button--button button--normal button--highlight button--primary button--disclose "
			href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/targeting-new-investors-research-re"
			target="_self"
			style=""
		>
			Targeting New Investors Report 2024		</a>

		
		</div>

		


<p class="has-text-align-center has-small-font-size">(Members Only)</p>



<h5 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-earnings-process-practices"><strong>Earnings Process Practices</strong></h5>



<p>Earnings announcements are significant cyclical events in the annual lifecycle for many public companies and a key communications vehicle to shareholders and other stakeholders. NIRI tracks trends in earnings announcement processes and other IR practices to help organizations benchmark against their peers. This report presents both 2023 survey results and trends from NIRI corporate investor relations members, detailing earnings process practices including: Quiet Periods, Earnings Guidance, Earnings Releases, Earnings Calls, and Post-Earnings Calls.</p>



		<div class="button-group button-group--justify-center button-group--align-top ">
			

		<a
			class="button button--button button--normal button--highlight button--primary button--disclose "
			href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/niri-2023-earnings-process-practice"
			target="_self"
			style=""
		>
			Earnings Process Practices Report 2023		</a>

		
		</div>

		


<p class="has-text-align-center has-small-font-size">(Members Only)</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-research-reports-by-niri-sponsors"><strong>Research Reports by NIRI Sponsors</strong></h3>



<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-9d6595d7 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:33.33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><a href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/2024-climate-disclosure-trends-in-i"><img decoding="async" width="251" height="164" src="https://niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Persefoni-2024.png" alt="2024 Climate Disclosure Trends in Investor Relations by Persefoni" class="wp-image-2311"/></a></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:66.66%">
<h6 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-2024-climate-disclosure-trends-in-investor-relations-by-persefoni"><strong><a href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/2024-climate-disclosure-trends-in-i">2024 Climate Disclosure Trends in Investor Relations by Persefoni</a></strong></h6>



<p>Persefoni collaborated with NIRI to collect data from NIRI members on climate disclosure trends in investor relations. This report explores companies&#8217; responses to investor demand for climate information, shedding light on their carbon disclosures, management responsibilities, challenges faced, and technology adoption plans, providing valuable insights for navigating the evolving landscape of climate disclosure.</p>
</div>
</div>



<hr class="wp-block-separator has-alpha-channel-opacity"/>



<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-9d6595d7 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:33.33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full"><a href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/2022-esg-pulse-report-by-dfin"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="200" height="284" src="https://niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/DFIN-2022.png" alt="2022 ESG Pulse Report by DFIN" class="wp-image-2309" style="object-fit:cover"/></a></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:66.66%">
<h6 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-2022-esg-pulse-report-by-dfin"><strong><a href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/2022-esg-pulse-report-by-dfin">2022 ESG Pulse Report by DFIN</a></strong></h6>



<p>DFIN collaborated with NIRI to collect environmental, social, and governance (ESG) perspectives from more than 100 IROs. It assessed a range of ESG topics affecting corporate investor relations officer (IRO) members professionally, their companies’ current ESG practices and reporting, and their anticipated future state.</p>
</div>
</div>



<hr class="wp-block-separator has-alpha-channel-opacity"/>



<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-9d6595d7 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:33.33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><a href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/2021-connectiq-global-100-report-b"><img decoding="async" width="250" height="164" src="https://niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/InvestisDigital-2021.jpg" alt="2021 Connect.IQ Global 100 Report by Investis Digital" class="wp-image-2310"/></a></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:66.66%">
<h6 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-2021-connect-iq-global-100-report-by-investis-digital"><strong><a href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/2021-connectiq-global-100-report-b">2021 Connect.IQ Global 100 Report by Investis Digital</a></strong></h6>



<p>Investis Digital collaborated with NIRI to survey IROs and corporate communications professionals on their 2021 digital priorities, and produced this “Global 100 Connect.IQ Special Report.&#8221;</p>
</div>
</div>



<hr class="wp-block-separator has-alpha-channel-opacity"/>



<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-9d6595d7 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:33.33%">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><a href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/the-state-of-investor-relations-in"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="961" height="542" src="https://niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/CisionReport-2021.png" alt="The State of Investor Relations in the Virtual World 2021" class="wp-image-2308" srcset="https://www.niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/CisionReport-2021.png 961w, https://www.niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/CisionReport-2021-300x169.png 300w, https://www.niri.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/CisionReport-2021-768x433.png 768w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 961px) 100vw, 961px" /></a></figure>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:66.66%">
<h6 class="wp-block-heading" id="h-the-state-of-investor-relations-in-the-virtual-world-2021"><strong><a href="https://community.niri.org/viewdocument/the-state-of-investor-relations-in">The State of Investor Relations in the Virtual World 2021</a></strong></h6>



<p>Cision collaborated with NIRI to survey senior IR leaders from companies representing a broad set of industries and market caps to capture their views on how they responded to an unprecedented year with a crisis around every corner — and where they see the industry headed.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<script id="wp-block-template-skip-link-js-after">
	( function() {
		var skipLinkTarget = document.querySelector( 'main' ),
			sibling,
			skipLinkTargetID,
			skipLink;

		// Early exit if a skip-link target can't be located.
		if ( ! skipLinkTarget ) {
			return;
		}

		/*
		 * Get the site wrapper.
		 * The skip-link will be injected in the beginning of it.
		 */
		sibling = document.querySelector( '.wp-site-blocks' );

		// Early exit if the root element was not found.
		if ( ! sibling ) {
			return;
		}

		// Get the skip-link target's ID, and generate one if it doesn't exist.
		skipLinkTargetID = skipLinkTarget.id;
		if ( ! skipLinkTargetID ) {
			skipLinkTargetID = 'wp--skip-link--target';
			skipLinkTarget.id = skipLinkTargetID;
		}

		// Create the skip link.
		skipLink = document.createElement( 'a' );
		skipLink.classList.add( 'skip-link', 'screen-reader-text' );
		skipLink.id = 'wp-skip-link';
		skipLink.href = '#' + skipLinkTargetID;
		skipLink.innerText = 'Skip to content';

		// Inject the skip link.
		sibling.parentElement.insertBefore( skipLink, sibling );
	}() );
	
//# sourceURL=wp-block-template-skip-link-js-after
</script>
